name: OPTEX GROUP Company, Limited
summary: OPTEX GROUP Company, Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in planning, development, and sale of sensors in Japan, the United States, Europe, and Asia. The company operates through Sensing Solution Business, Industrial Automation Business, and Electronic Manufacturing Service Business segments.
